semantics: Only is may omit on; on is has identical meaning. Literal before nominal type is ordered specialization. Unreachable arms remain diagnosed. Unsupported types must fail closed, not count as positive parity. Membership arms use in collection; type lists use is in [T,U]; no ons. All added vectors are targets, not execution receipts.

fnc choose(int | string value): int { return value |> match over { on 42 -> 100; is int -> -20; on _ -> 0; }; }
